canary.design: One create-only trivial exact-output microcase projected once onto each exact route. Every spawn contains the case file identity but no case contents. No parent follow-up is sent.
canary.purpose: Test the exact create_goal-before-read ordering, auto-continuation, active and complete receipts, trace attestation, exact scoring, route requests, and no reuse. Canary credit remains zero.

allowed_native_controller_calls_per_case.interrupt_agent: 0 unless bounded terminal cleanup after a consumed failure

controller_contract.task_name: r9_goal_case_ followed by case_id without punctuation

design.root_controller: ACTIVE ROOT AGENT SPAWNS ONE FRESH TASK ONCE AND SENDS NO FOLLOWUP_TASK, send_message, WAIT REQUEST, RETRY, OR RESUME
structural_distinction: THE ONLY CONTROLLER-TO-TEST-TAKER MESSAGE IS THE INITIAL SPAWN MESSAGE; THERE IS NO IDLE OR RESIDENT WAIT STATE AND NO PARENT FOLLOW-UP GATE
THE SPAWN MESSAGE CONTAINS CONTROL ORDER, OPAQUE RUN/CASE IDENTITIES, OPAQUE FILE PATH, AND FILE SHA256 BUT ZERO QUESTION, SOURCE EXCERPT, ANSWER CHOICE, OUTPUT CONTRACT, OR EXPECTED OUTPUT BYTES
THE TEST TAKER FIRST CREATES AND ATTESTS ITS OWN NATIVE GOAL, THEN AUTO-CONTINUES IN THE SAME TURN TO OPEN THE BOUNDED SUBJECT FILE, ANSWER ONCE, COMPLETE THE SAME GOAL, AND RETURN
GOAL AUTO-CONTINUATION IS THE OWNED EXECUTION MECHANISM INSTEAD OF AN ERROR TO SUPPRESS

STATIC INDEPENDENTLY SCOREABLE MICROCASE CONTENT IS REUSED, BUT THE REJECTED PARENT-FOLLOWUP LIFECYCLE, DYNAMIC DAG, REDUCER, CHUNK, FINAL-TRIGGER, MAILBOX, CAPSULE, SKILL, AND FULL-CORPUS PROTOCOLS ARE ABSENT

failure_and_loop_breaker.first_mismatch: Consume the case and run, preserve exact evidence, abort unlaunched cases, grant zero credit, and do not send corrective content.
failure_and_loop_breaker.same_family_recurrence: Any review or canary mismatch in subject-byte absence, create_goal-before-read ordering, raw Goal receipts, auto-continuation, single-turn settlement, or trace attestation rejects this single-turn deferred-file family with no narrow patch; pivot the active project Goal.

matrix_scale_gate.coverage: Independent review must prove microcases are jointly necessary and sufficient for each unchanged cell obligation. No model reducer or empirical output may fill a gap.
matrix_scale_gate.full_matrix: All predeclared microcases on all routes complete under this exact single-turn lifecycle. Cell-route and matrix results are mechanical conjunctions only.
matrix_scale_gate.pair: Two fresh matrix IDs, fresh task/Goal/case identities, identical reviewed owner bundle and scoring bar, sequential launch only after Matrix 1 passes.
matrix_scale_gate.static_microcase_content_model: Before any matrix mint, a private owner bundle must fully materialize independently scoreable microcases for all 97 unchanged semantic cells and project each case to all three exact routes.

pre_goal_visibility.opaque_path_rule: The basename is exactly {case_id}.json under the fixed directory cases/. No semantic word may occur in matrix_id, case_id, task_name, or any path component.
pre_goal_visibility.subject_first_visibility: The first subject byte may enter model context only as output of the exact file-read tool call after create_goal returned ACTIVE and the raw ACTIVE receipt was sent to /root.

private_scorer.score_rule: Exact test-taker result bytes must equal expected_output_utf8 UTF-8 bytes. No normalization, trimming, JSON reparsing, punctuation repair, semantic equivalence, or best-of selection is allowed.
private_scorer.storage: Create-only private root disjoint and nonnested from public cases and runtime evidence.

qualification.rule: Only two consecutive independently verified complete full matrices under the same reviewed owner bundle, scorer, and single-turn lifecycle may change 0/2.

review_requirements: PROVE THE SPAWN MESSAGE CONTAINS ZERO SUBJECT CONTENT BYTES AND ONLY OPAQUE FILE IDENTITY
PROVE CREATE_GOAL ACTIVE AND ROOT-VISIBLE ACTIVE RECEIPT PRECEDE THE FIRST SUBJECT FILE READ
PROVE GOAL AUTO-CONTINUATION NEEDS NO PARENT FOLLOW-UP OR WAIT STATE
PROVE ONE SMALL CASE, ONE RESULT, SAME-GOAL COMPLETE, TRACE ATTESTATION, AND NO REUSE
PROVE STATIC SCOREABILITY, EXACT ROUTES, OMP SEPARATION, FAILURE PRESERVATION, AND 0/2

runtime_evidence.freshness: task_name, canonical task path, Goal threadId, matrix_id, case_id, subject path, scorer path, evidence path, and rollout identity are unique across all preserved runs.
runtime_evidence.inventory: Exact listed regular nonlink create-only files only; every identity reopened before accounting.
runtime_evidence.result_source: Only the exact collaboration.send_message result emitted between subject read and update_goal may be scored; task-final prose is lifecycle evidence only.

spawn_message.framing: Exact UTF-8 bytes with no implicit prefix, suffix, markdown fence, or terminal LF.
spawn_message.goal_objective_literal: R9 {case_id}; run {matrix_id}; one case; no retry.
spawn_message.literal: Create Goal "{goal_objective}". If not ACTIVE, stop unread. Send /root ACTIVE receipt. Then open only {subject_path}; require {subject_bytes} bytes and SHA256 {subject_sha256}; answer its one case; send result; complete Goal; send receipt; return. No follow-up/retry/delegation.

subject_file.canonicalization: Finite duplicate-key-free JSON, no BOM, no floats or nonfinite numbers; Python json.dumps(value,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False).encode('utf-8') plus exactly one LF.
subject_file.public_expected_value_leak: No expected output, scorer path, semantic expected hash, or correctness hint may appear.

trace_attestation.fail_closed: Missing rollout, ambiguous path, malformed event, unpaired tool call/result, extra model turn, ordering mismatch, or subject evidence before ACTIVE fails the case and matrix.
trace_attestation.pre_goal_absence: Before the ACTIVE create_goal result, the rollout must contain zero subject-file substrings of length at least 16, zero question bytes, zero source excerpt bytes, zero answer-choice bytes, zero output-contract bytes, and zero subject-path read calls.
required_order: first subject file read tool call
trace_attestation.source: Exact fresh child Codex rollout JSONL located by the ACTIVE Goal threadId after task terminal.
trace_attestation.subject_read_definition: The first tool event whose arguments name the exact opaque subject_path or whose output contains any exact subject-file byte substring of length at least 32.
